Copied Aave debt repayment: bounded public transaction audit
Research date: 29 September 2026. This study reads public historical logs, receipts, block headers,
reserve metadata and verified source. It submits no transactions and performs no local simulations.
Findings
There are genuine post-fork Aave V3 repayments, including material copied-USDT and copied-USDC
payments by the examined addresses. Across the examined pool and interval, standard Repay events
report 2,925,550.790450 USDT and 407,302.146331 USDC. Representative large repayments have
matching underlying transfers into the reserve's aT oken contract and reconciled debt-token events.
Three examined wallets occur as indexed repayers. Some payments explicitly reduce another examined
wallet's debt.
The same audit finds only 444 raw wei of DAI, or 0.000000000000000444 DAI, in four standard DAI
repayment events. One such 111-wei payment triggers an approximately 4.805-million-DAI debt-token 
Mint event reflecting accrued interest. That large accounting event is not a payment of 4.805 million DAI.
The distinction is material when interpreting explorer transfer views.
No standard Aave V2 Repay events were returned over the same interval. Its implementation was
replaced after the fork with explorer-unverified code, so this finding cannot exclude a nonstandard debt
adjustment at that address. The V3 totals measure gross recorded repayment, not net system debt
decline, retained reserve cash, dollar value or a proven bridge-funded purchase loop.
Scope and method
The pools are copied Aave V2 0x7d2768de32b0b80b7a3454c06bdac94a69ddc7a9 and copied Aave V3 
0x87870bca3f3fd6335c3f4ce8392d69350b4fa4e2, on PulseChain chain 369. The explicit post-fork range is 
17,233,000–27,659,393. The ending block hash is 
0xc5e582cd902f4bff3b1aa325b9b564fcd5d6dc0ffa77a03fcd105b65c6390275, rechecked after collection. The ending
block timestamp is 28 September 2026 08:22:35 UTC. This is not a search of other Aave
deployments or all token transfers on PulseChain.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 70

The verified original V2 and V3 implementations establish different signatures:
V2: Repay(address,address,address,uint256).
V3: Repay(address,address,address,uint256,bool).
The three indexed addresses are reserve underlying, debt beneficiary and repayer. V3's final field
indicates repayment using aT okens. The direct eth_getLogs requests succeeded without returned errors: 
zero V2 events, and 383 V3 events across 71 distinct transactions. All returned V3 events have 
useATokens = false. T oken decimals and symbols were read at the pinned block. For a representative
largest event in each asset, historical getReserveData at that event's block identifies the actual aT oken and
debt-token addresses. The associated receipt, transaction and block header were retrieved and checked.
Original V2 implementation source, V3 implementation and dependency source.
Aggregate results by asset
Amounts are whole units of the indicated copied token, not external-dollar valuations. They must not be
added across assets as though each unit had the same value.

The event count needs context: 321 of the 325 WETH events are eleven wei each, and another is
one wei. The remaining WETH payments are 10, 1 and 75.003562721157874144 whole tokens. A high
count therefore does not imply a similarly large paid amount. The returned events span 9 July 2023–25
November 2025; no standard V3 repayment event occurs in the searched later interval through the
principal block. The observed payments consequently do not show a new repayment wave following the
August 2026 stkAAVE upgrade.

Representative receipts and debt reconciliation
All six representative receipts are successful, contain the queried repayment log at the expected block
hash, and contain an underlying transfer of the exact repaid amount from the indexed repayer to the
historically identified aT oken contract.
Asset UTC date Amount Receipt
USDT 19 October 2023 290,000 Transaction
USDC 19 October 2023 100,000 Transaction
DAI 26 August 2024 111 wei Transaction
WETH 25 November 2025 75.003562721157874144 Transaction
rETH 22 March 2025 84.082619990302430868 Transaction
cbETH 8 January 2024 55 Transaction
V3's verified BorrowLogic.executeRepay calls the relevant debt token's burn, updates reserve accounting, and,
for these underlying-funded payments, transfers underlying to the aT oken contract before emitting Repay.
Debt-token event values reflect interest crystallization as well as the current payment. In the
representative USDT receipt, the variable-debt Burn value is 289,853.874610 USDT, with balanceIncrease
146.125390 USDT. Their sum is the actual 290,000 USDT paid. Similarly, the representative USDC
burn value 99,949.802554 plus accrued balance increase 50.197446 equals the 100,000 USDC
payment. The WETH, rETH and cbETH representatives reconcile in the same way. This establishes more
than an isolated ERC-20 transfer label. Verified repayment and scaled-balance interfaces.
Why a large debt-token Mint can accompany a tiny repayment
In the DAI representative, examined wallet 0x48fc8b22ae5319786a8e25ef49b1b49942000000 pays 111 raw wei
DAI on behalf of examined wallet 0x6e3bf3c7bd91144d694621298cb8da370479a7bb. The underlying DAI transfer
into aDAI is exactly 111 wei. The variable-debt token at 0xcf8d0c70c850859266f5c338b38f9d663181c314 emits a
Mint with:
Accrued balance increase: 4,805,376.907763045679338591 DAI
Debt-token Mint value:   4,805,376.907763045679338480 DAI
Difference:                         0.000000000000000111 DAI
The interface explicitly documents that a burn call can emit a Mint when accrued interest exceeds the
amount repaid. The receipt exactly reconciles to that case. The approximately 4.805-million amount is
crystallized debt interest net of a tiny payment; it is not 4.805 million underlying DAI transferred or debt
paid off. Counting debt-token Mint/Burn/Transfer values as stablecoin repayments without this
reconciliation would misclassify the transaction. Receipt.
Links to the seven examined addresses
Three examined addresses occur in the indexed repayment fields. T otals below group by the event's 
repayer, not the top-level transaction sender and not the debt beneficiary:

Examined repayer Asset Events Gross amount

8cb8da370479a7bb

Same address USDC 16 380,000
0xc000000be68420c4be47ee70

49b1b49942000000
cbETH 3 42.014212052571746658
Same address WETH 4 1.000000000000000033
Same address USDT 1 10
Same address DAI 2 0.000000000000000222
One receipt confirms c000… repaying 200,000 USDT on 19 October 2023. Another confirms 6e3b… paying 
1,000 USDT on behalf of c000… on the same date. A third confirms 48fc… paying 10 USDT on behalf
of c000… on 16 August 2024. These are specific on-chain financial relationships, stronger than merely
interacting with the same application. They do not establish common private-key ownership or a named
person's identity. c000 payment, 6e3b on-behalf payment, 48fc on-behalf payment.
Viewed by beneficiary, c000 has 706,010 USDT repaid, including its own 705,000 plus the two
payments above. Wallet 6e3b has 2,160,000 USDT, 380,000 USDC and 444 wei DAI repaid on its
debt positions. Beneficiary and payer totals describe the same events from different perspectives and
must not be added together.
No indexed repayer or beneficiary matches were found for examined e121 
0x98c89980d1eae247ada3636ae27648f78e66e121, FdbEE32 0xfdbee32bcf68bb0ced033200373384a619c71967, BAD9 
0xbad9dff1026e59ea4c39cc3398aa5eb6f6f229ac, or the copied rollup 0x5ef0d09d1e6204141b4d37530808ed19f60fba35. This
limited result does not exclude funding, contract-mediated or unrelated protocol activity by them.
Interpretation limits
The observed payments validate part of the debt-repayment claim, but not a claim that large quantities
of DAI have already been paid into these pools. Gross repayments do not equal the decrease in
outstanding debt between two dates: new borrowing, accrued interest, liquidations, debt-mode
conversions and other debt changes must also be reconciled. Nor do gross repayments equal cash
permanently retained by Aave; other actions may withdraw or borrow the underlying later, including
within the same transaction. The rETH representative, for example, contains additional underlying
inflows and outflows, so its repay amount cannot be treated as the transaction's net reserve-cash
increase.
The absence of standard V2 repayment events is especially bounded. The original V2 implementation at
the start of the interval is explorer-verified, but the two July 2023 replacement implementations are not.
Their upgrade history is documented in the Aave governance study (Appendix 2). Standard event
absence cannot rule out storage writes or alternative interfaces in replacement code. Conversely, one
cannot infer that such unobserved writes actually happened.
This audit excludes liquidation-specific debt settlement and other event types from the Repay total. It
does not reconstruct all borrowing or prove an external dollar valuation. No funding provenance from
pARB, Portal issuance or a Curve rebalance has been demonstrated by these repayment receipts. That
would require matching the relevant earlier transfers and protocol events, rather than attributing a
mechanism from the fact that debt was repaid.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 73

Evidence preservation and reproduction
The explicit batch is ignored artifacts/parb-debt-history-20260929/. requests.json records the pinned header,
signature hashes and full-range eth_getLogs requests. V2_repay_logs.json and V3_repay_logs.json retain the
responses. largest_receipt_evidence.json contains metadata calls, historical reserve reads and receipts for
the six representatives; supplied_wallet_receipts.json contains the three additional wallet examples,
boundary timestamps and ending-block hash recheck. repayment_summary.json records exact raw totals,
decimal-normalized totals, representative receipt references, underlying-transfer checks and debt-event
reconciliations. Verified-source responses are retained alongside them.
Reproduction consists of replaying these read-only RPC requests at the stated blocks, grouping each
Repay log by indexed reserve, and dividing raw amounts by the corresponding 10^decimals. Separate
every receipt by transaction hash and log index to avoid duplication. The selected receipt checks
establish representative execution; this pass did not fetch all 71 transaction receipts. The aggregate
counts and totals derive from the RPC's complete returned event list, not a claim of independent
consensus verification or an exhaustive whole-ecosystem debt audit.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 74
